description: This file defines authentication API functions for a React-based application, including registration, login, token refresh, and logout, by making HTTP requests via an apiClient.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant user by sending a POST request to /auth/register with email and password.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Validates user credentials and possibly MFA, sending a POST to /auth/login, storing tokens if received.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens by POST to /auth/refresh and updating stored tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token via POST to /auth/logout.
